thesis: The thesis is intact: GMAB held its 10-day low of 50.24 and bounced from the 50.6 close to 53.12 (+5%), trend is up (SMA20 53.19 > SMA50 43.39 > SMA200 32.12, RSI14 61.7), and healthcare (XLV) is one of three sectors above its 50-day in a risk-off tape. However, price has run about 3.5% above the morning zone top of 51.3, and at the 53.12 last price reward/risk to 57.3 against the 49.9 stop is only about 1.3 (reward 4.18, risk 3.22), below the 1.5 floor, so per lesson 3 this is downgraded to Hold. It goes back to Overweight only on a dip into 51.6-52.6 (midpoint 52.1 gives about 2.4 reward/risk); do not chase.
invalidation: A daily close below 49.9 (under the 10-day swing low of 50.24) ends the post-gap consolidation and opens a gap-fill toward the 20-day low of 43.98.
key_risks: Entry ran away: at the 53.12 last price reward/risk is about 1.3, and today's bounce came on light volume (vol_ratio 0.65, partial day) while price sits right at the SMA20 (53.19)
Post-gap structure is still lower highs and lower lows since the 10/28 gap to 59.97 (closes 57.06, 55.8, 53.87, 52.4 highs), so today's bounce may be just another lower high
Broad risk-off regime at 0.95 confidence (QQQ 21-day -13.63%, VIX 31.34 at the 0.991 percentile) could pressure a stock up 97.6% over 126 days as funds raise cash

Valuation on earnings is stretched (trailing PE 45.4, forward PE 33.6) with earnings growth -0.147 and total debt 5.198B above cash 1.871B; SEC quarterly series empty, and the October catalysts are known only from an IBD recap
Stop moved from the morning's 49.4 to the technical card's 49.9 (just under the 50.24 swing low); it is about 1.1 ATR (2.09) below the 52.1 entry, so noise can trigger it
Correlated healthcare exposure: per lessons, cap combined healthcare weight rather than sizing GMAB alone
